proposal.reason: Main change is in logical graph channel/ring construction and mapping, owned by graph-search: src/graph/connect.cc adds ringReverse propagation, applies reversal post node assignment, preserves per-algorithm channelMap through copy/shuffle, and fixes compCap80/89 channel remapping semantics. src/graph/search.cc switches net/proxy lookup to graph->channelMap and validates cached proxy by sender+NIC before path fallback, which is part of graph channel/rank connection logic. src/init.cc and tests are supporting wiring/validation for this graph behavior, not an independent module policy change.
